sql: WITH RECURSIVE seeds AS (SELECT m.*, 'snapshot' kind,(SELECT SUM(qty) FROM inventory WHERE product_id=m.product_id) init FROM product_minimums m UNION ALL SELECT m.*,'purchases_minus_sales',(SELECT SUM(qty) FROM purchases WHERE product_id=m.product_id)-(SELECT SUM(qty) FROM monthly_sales WHERE product_id=m.product_id) FROM product_minimums m UNION ALL SELECT m.*,'2018_purchases_minus_sales',(SELECT SUM(qty) FROM purchases WHERE product_id=m.product_id AND purchased>='2018-01-01')-(SELECT SUM(qty) FROM monthly_sales WHERE product_id=m.product_id AND mth>='2018-01-01') FROM product_minimums m UNION ALL SELECT m.*,'dec_purchase_stock',(SELECT SUM(i.qty) FROM inventory i JOIN purchases p ON i.purchase_id=p.id WHERE i.product_id=m.product_id AND p.purchased>='2018-12-01') FROM product_minimums m), modes(mode) AS (VALUES('immediate_add'),('delayed_add'),('immediate_set'),('delayed_set'),('immediate_topup'),('inclusive_add')), demand_year(y) AS(VALUES(2019),(2018)), rec(product_id,kind,mode,y,n,mn,pq,ending,pre) AS (SELECT s.product_id,s.kind,m.mode,y.y,0,s.qty_minimum,s.qty_purchase,s.init,s.init FROM seeds s CROSS JOIN modes m CROSS JOIN demand_year y UNION ALL SELECT r.product_id,r.kind,r.mode,r.y,r.n+1,r.mn,r.pq,CASE r.mode WHEN 'immediate_add' THEN r.ending-b.qty+CASE WHEN r.ending-b.qty<r.mn THEN r.pq ELSE 0 END WHEN 'delayed_add' THEN r.ending+CASE WHEN r.ending<r.mn THEN r.pq ELSE 0 END-b.qty WHEN 'immediate_set' THEN CASE WHEN r.ending-b.qty<r.mn THEN r.pq ELSE r.ending-b.qty END WHEN 'delayed_set' THEN CASE WHEN r.ending<r.mn THEN r.pq ELSE r.ending END-b.qty WHEN 'immediate_topup' THEN MAX(r.mn,r.ending-b.qty) WHEN 'inclusive_add' THEN r.ending-b.qty+CASE WHEN r.ending-b.qty<=r.mn THEN r.pq ELSE 0 END END,r.ending-b.qty FROM rec r JOIN monthly_budget b ON r.product_id=b.product_id AND b.mth=printf('%d-%02d-01',r.y,r.n+1) WHERE n<12), allmetric AS(SELECT *,ABS(ending-mn) diff,'post' metric FROM rec WHERE n>0 UNION ALL SELECT *,ABS(pre-mn),'pre' FROM rec WHERE n>0), ranked AS(SELECT *,MIN(diff) OVER(PARTITION BY product_id,kind,mode,y,metric) mindiff FROM allmetric) SELECT product_id,kind,mode,y,metric,mindiff,GROUP_CONCAT(n) months FROM ranked WHERE diff=mindiff GROUP BY product_id,kind,mode,y,metric ORDER BY product_id,kind,mode,y,metric
